spans.s:
ऐशान a. [ईशान-अण्] Belonging
to Śiva.
--नी
1 The northeastern
direction.
--2 N. of Durgā.

ऐषमस् ind. During this year,
in the present year.

ऐषमस्तन^1 --मस्त्य a. Belonging to
the present year.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170110. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/332,. note: badly printed.
